title: GenPlus
description: A modpack designed for the GenMC server.
body:
🌱 GenPlus — Vanilla+ Fabric Modpack

GenPlus is a Fabric-based Vanilla+ modpack designed to enhance Minecraft’s core gameplay while preserving the look, feel, and progression of vanilla.

The pack focuses on quality-of-life improvements, exploration tools, performance stability, and builder-friendly enhancements — adding depth where it makes sense without overcomplicating the experience.

GenPlus serves as the foundation modpack for the GenMC server, but it is fully playable in single-player or other multiplayer environments.

✨ What to Expect

Thoughtful quality-of-life improvements that feel natural
Enhanced exploration and world awareness
Strong emphasis on performance and stability
Builder-focused tools that support creativity without altering progression
A curated set of mods designed to work cleanly together

🧱 Notable Mods & Tools

GenPlus includes several widely used and trusted mods to support both builders and everyday players, such as:

WorldEdit – efficient building and large-scale edits
Litematica – schematic creation and build planning
Mapping & navigation tools – improved world awareness and exploration
Core libraries & APIs – ensuring compatibility and long-term stability
(Exact mod versions and dependencies are managed per release.)

🌍 GenMC Community & Server

GenPlus is designed around the GenMC community and serves as the foundation modpack for its Semi-Vanilla experience.

Beyond gameplay, the community actively shares builds, schematics, and creative ideas to help improve the overall experience for everyone. This collaborative approach allows players to learn from one another, refine designs, and contribute to the growth of the world and the pack itself.

🌐 Website: https://www.genmc.net/
🖥️ Server IP: semivanilla.genmc.net
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ubDxMdQZ

Join the community to play, build, collaborate, and share creations while staying up to date with pack updates and ongoing projects.

⚙️ Technical Details

Mod Loader: Fabric
Includes required libraries and APIs
Designed with multiplayer consistency in mind
Clear changelogs provided with updates
